title: Object Storage: outage authorize handling
content:
Object Storage outage authorize is handled on request. The customer authorizes one exact storage refund to its recorded original-payment destination. The selected refund authorization becomes posted with its consented cash amount and both notice and occurrence set to the current filing time; the receipt confirms customer consent is recorded without granting a system approval.

## Invocation

authorize_storage_refund_9b3e6afe. This tool must first be unlocked (unlock) and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the refund authorization being updated, copied from storage_event_id of the selected refund request returned by find_storage_events; this is the same identifier supplied as request_id. This is the outage authorize input.
- request_id: Id class — Identifier recorded as this refund authorization's own request reference, copied from storage_event_id of the selected refund request returned by find_storage_events; this is the same identifier supplied as storage_event_id. This is the outage authorize input.
- source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the original completed payment, copied from source_event_id of the selected refund request returned by find_storage_events. This is the outage authorize input.
- related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the current posted service concession, copied from its actual posting receipt. This is the outage authorize input.
- storage_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the storage contract copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage authorize input.
- credited_amount: Fixed-format class — Unit USD; format USD to two decimals. Nonnegative claim or authorization amount as a decimal number, rounded half-up before submission and stored to two decimal places; empty is not allowed. This is the outage authorize input.

## Successful return

For outage authorize, a string reading Recorded with the storage business record identifier and the USD amount; Recorded confirms that the stated action completed successfully.
